topic: Stop saying that AI is just a tool and it only matters how it is used
headline: AI Isn't Just a Tool
caption: As a full stack engineer, I’ve seen firsthand how the context and implementation of AI determine its impact. Saying it’s just a tool downplays the responsibility we have in shaping its behavior. From training data biases to platform controls, each decision influences the end result. We must go beyond the idea that AI is neutral and recognize our role in guiding its development responsibly. Thinking more critically about how we build and deploy AI helps us avoid unintended consequences and builds trust. 🤖 Let’s stay conscious of our influence and keep pushing for ethical AI. #AIethics #FullStackEngineer #TechResponsibility
